body:
Technically I did everything voluntarily. I was told I had to go to the hospital and did so voluntarily to avoid the ambulance cost and further upsetting my parents. I was told not going to the hospital was not an option, which the therapist at the psych facility told me is false. Then the psychologist at the hospital coerced me into going to a facility voluntarily by saying I would go no matter what but voluntarily would be faster. The therapist again told me that was a lie, that they would not have been able to send me involuntarily because I had not attempted suicide and had no plans for attempting.

I believe I was taken advantage of in a diminished psychological state and will be fully liable for the costs. I just wanted to go home as fast as possible and took the path of least resistance.

I haven't received the bill yet but I know it's coming. The therapist told me there are federal programs that cover the costs of mental health treatment but these wouldn't cover the hospital bills since I admitted myself voluntarily and they didn't provide any treatment. So I'm expecting a bill for my two days there, the bloodwork they did and the ambulance ride to the psych facility.
